chk_scale.note: FLAG: no calipers, no scale reference in the catalogue photos (DECISIONS.md MEASUREMENTS). Units assumed mm, scale unverified, no scale applied.

primary.desc: band top face: up-facing annular step (r 10-11.5) where the body cylinder leaves the band ring
primary.why: flat perpendicular to the valve axis at the band/body assembly interface; the cleanest scanned flat (rms 0.027 over seeds 0-7, vs nozzle shoulder 0.041-0.042 and cap top 0.044-0.046, intake/noise_plane_*.json); its normal agrees with the body-cylinder axis and the nozzle-shoulder normal within ~0.4 deg (rough-frame exploration)

xy.why: nozzle = the plug-in spigot of the valve (the functional insertion axis); cleanest circle on the part

origin.definition: nozzle OD axis ∩ band top face plane

clock.why: the side outlet (threaded, O-ring sealed) is the second functional port; its collar face is the cleanest flat whose normal is the outlet axis

landmarks.name: nozzle tip (zmin)
landmarks.tol_source: rough-frame exploration value (tilt <= 1 deg x r 6 = 0.1) + 0.3 exploration binning

landmarks.name: nozzle shoulder (median z)
landmarks.tol_source: rough-frame r-z map read to +-0.2 + tilt

landmarks.name: cap top (median z)
landmarks.tol_source: rough-frame r-z map; cap measured tilted ~2.5 deg (x r 11 = 0.5)
